column1: # mapping_set_title: XDI dictionary terms to CDIF XAS concepts (all detection modes)
# mapping_set_description: One of two bindings onto the CDIF XAS concept hub. Subject IRIs are minted under CDIF w3id because the XDI specification defines none. Scope is the transmission slice.
